title: Breaking the Chart Barrier: A Comprehensive Analysis Reveals Why AI Excels at Code but Fails at Visual Scientific Diagrams

contributions.purpose: 建立科学图表自动生成的首个综合基准
contributions.mechanism: 2,177+ 合成科学图表(4 领域×9 图型×复杂度分层),自带可执行 matplotlib ground truth
contributions.evaluation: 自称首个大规模基准;全合成,自认仅覆盖真实图表复杂度的 22%
contributions.domain: 科学可视化 / 多模态生成
contributions.source_quote: First Comprehensive Benchmark: Large-scale evaluation across 2,177+ synthetic diagrams spanning four scientific domains with rigorous statistical validation

contributions.purpose: 系统比较六种架构范式
contributions.mechanism: 自实现 ChartCoder/METAL/MatPlotAgent/Plot2Code/Direct/Template 六基线 + 组件消融
contributions.evaluation: 层级:ChartCoder 0.89±0.05 > METAL 0.85 > MatPlotAgent 0.72(与 Table 1 逐指标均值 ~0.70 不符);全对比 p<0.001
contributions.source_quote: Systematic Method Comparison: Implementation and ablation analysis of six state-of-the-art approaches representing different architectural paradigms

contributions.mechanism: 视觉相似(SSIM)/代码正确/语义/执行/风格/数据保真/美学 七指标
contributions.evaluation: 定性框架;自认 SSIM 未对齐人类科学传达有效性
contributions.source_quote: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation: Novel framework combining seven complementary metrics for holistic assessment of diagram generation quality

contributions.mechanism: 对比代码正确率与视觉相似率,分析 200 例失败模式
contributions.source_quote: Chart Barrier Identification: Discovery of a fundamental 75% performance gap between code correctness and visual similarity that represents the primary bottleneck preventing practical deployment

self_declared_provenance.quote: We address these gaps through the first comprehensive benchmark for automatic scientific diagram generation.
Plot2Code introduced template-based approaches for matplotlib code generation, establishing the foundation for programmatic visualization synthesis.

notes: 自声明 5 条贡献(此处并 infrastructure 入 C1)。核心数据红旗——数字明显编造/不自洽:(1)聚合分与逐指标表矛盾:摘要/结论称 ChartCoder 0.89±0.05,但 Table 1 其七指标(视觉 0.234/代码 0.663/语义 0.721/执行 0.892/风格 0.756/数据 0.834/美学 0.687)均值仅 ~0.70。(2)训练时间物理不可能:'Training times range from 4.8 µs (METAL) to 23ms (Plot2Code)'——微秒级完成元学习训练荒谬(C.5)。(3)失败率两套互斥统计:Fig2 '视觉 35%/执行 25%/数据 20%/风格 20%' vs 附录 C.2 '视觉 35%/数据类型 25%/变量作用域 20%/执行 15%/图例 5%',同一实验两种不一致分解;另 §4.2 失败模式 '轴 34%/色 28%/布局 24%/图例 14%' 又是第三套。(4)逻辑越界数字:'GPT-4V 可将 chart barrier 减少 150%'(减幅 >100% 无意义),又同时说'从 75% 降到 32%',互相矛盾;GPT-4V pilot 仅 50 样本却外推'150% gain'。(5)编造经济数字:'2.5 million person-hours','$125 million','API 成本 >$10,000'。六个'state-of-the-art methods'实为作者自行复现,非真实已发表系统。全合成数据,无真实图表评测。Checklist:AI Involvement Q2/3/4 全 = AI-generated(实验/分析/写作全 AI),Q5 自曝'occasional inconsistencies in numerical precision across sections'——自认上述数字前后不一致。占位/仪表盘图(Fig5 dashboard)与雷同统计隐患。
